title: PH may appeal possible death sentence for Filipino in Laos drug bust

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Philippine authorities will likely ask the Laotian government to commute any death sentence imposed on a Filipino arrested in connection with the seizure of a private aircraft loaded with half a ton of shabu (methamphetamine hydrochloride), National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) officer Ross Jonathan Galicia said Thursday.
